City of Chicago
                                                                   O2022-2464
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 7/20/2022
Sponsor(s):                    Martin (47)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-H at 3226-3228 N
                              Lincoln Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

       SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code pf Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the Cl-3, Neighborhood Commercial District symbols as
shown on Map No. 9-H for the property located in the area bounded by
       West Melrose Street; North Lincoln Avenue to a point 47.94 feet southeast of West
       Melrose Street; a line perpendicular to North Lincoln Avenue extending to a point
       96.85 feet south of West Melrose Street; the public alley next west of North Lincoln
       Avenue
to those of a 83-3, Community Shopping District.
       SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and publication.


Common Address:              3226 - 3228 North Lincoln Avenue




                                                                          MATT^WEW MARTIN
                                                                          Alderman, 47th Ward
